text_description: Cropped runway look shown from upper torso to knees, centered on a cream and black tailored ensemble layered over a fitted chocolate-brown top. The top is smooth and close to the body with a clean, high-cut visible neckline area cropped by the frame, sitting under an open ivory outer layer with pale sleeves and dark black front edging that appears textured or embellished. The bottom is an ivory knee-length skirt with a straight, close pencil/wrap-like silhouette, a smooth waistband, and softly draped fabric across the front hip. Bold irregular black bands create graphic construction lines: a vertical strip runs down the front right side, a horizontal/angled strip crosses the lower front panel, and black edging frames the hem and side openings. A narrow gold chain trim accents the lower front hem edge and small chain details appear near the side openings. Additional ivory side panels from the open outer layer hang past the skirt with black border trim, creating movement and layered vertical lines at both sides. The palette is warm ivory, black, chocolate brown, and gold, with the styling reading polished, graphic, and dressy, combining tailored proportions with fluid hanging panels and chain accents.
